table.name: TLGNR_SAP_LANGUAGE_BS
table.description: All languages as known in SAP, as used in fields SPRAS_ISO in various tables. Columns in LOGON DB which represent the original values from SAP must reference to this table, whereas all fields which contain language information about the languages truly supported by the LOGON application (translations of text labels, masterdata, output documents…) refer to tlgnr_lang_bs/tx.

column.name: SAP_LANGUAGE_CD
column.description: PK. Possible keys are defined by SAP, appearance in various SPRAS_ISO fields.

column.name: MAP_TO_APPLICATION_LANG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Default/fallback of this SAP language into one of LOGON’s application languages.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
